definition.en: A single copy held by the library. Copies with the same title are tracked separately.
definition.ja: 図書館が所蔵する1冊。同じ題名の本も1冊ずつ区別する。

definition.en: A member currently eligible to borrow according to the membership authority.
definition.ja: 会員管理の正本で、現在貸出資格を持つ会員。

definition.en: A member considered eligible according to the information applied by lending. This may differ from the authority until a suspension is applied.
definition.ja: 貸出側が反映済みの情報で有効と判断する会員。資格停止の反映までは正本とずれることがある。

name.en: Member known to be active by lending
name.ja: 貸出側が有効と把握している会員

definition.en: The set of copies that have been lent at least once in this model.
definition.ja: このモデルでは、一度でも貸し出された蔵書の集合。
